name: Pre Diff Allen Institute Protocol
description: Pre Differentiation Allen Institute Protocol Template

steps.name: Split 0 — Day 0
steps.description: Thaw cells with mTeSR + TZV (2mL)

steps.name: Split 0 — Day 1
steps.description: Change media with mTeSR only (2mL)

steps.name: Split 0 — Day 3
steps.description: mTeSR (2mL), check for confluency 70-80% then split

steps.name: Split 1 — Day 0
steps.description: Seed cells with mTeSR + TZV (2mL)

steps.name: Split 1 — Day 1
steps.description: Change media with mTeSR only (2mL)

steps.name: Split 1 — Day 3
steps.description: mTeSR (2mL), check for confluency 70-80% then split

steps.name: Split 2 — Day 0
steps.description: Seed cells with mTeSR + TZV (2mL)

steps.name: Split 2 — Day 1
steps.description: Change media with mTeSR only (2mL)

steps.name: Split 2 — Day 3
steps.description: mTeSR (2mL), check for confluency 70-80% then split

steps.name: Split 3 — Day 0
steps.description: Seed cells with mTeSR + TZV (2mL)

steps.name: Split 3 — Day 1
steps.description: Change media with mTeSR only (2mL)

steps.name: Split 3 — Day 3
steps.description: mTeSR (2mL), check for confluency 70-80% then start differentiation

steps.name: Start Differentiation
steps.description: Replace media with 3 mL ADM + CHIR (7.5 uM)

steps.name: First media change
steps.description: Replace media with 3 mL ADM + IWP2 (5 uM) Allen Institute recommends that it be 48 hrs +/- 15 minutes or less.

steps.name: Second media change
steps.description: Replace media with 3 mL RPMI + B27(-) + Pen/Strep

steps.name: Third media change
steps.description: Replace media with 3 mL RPMI + B27(+) + Pen/Strep

steps.name: Media change every other day (1)
steps.description: Media change every other day RPMI + B27 (+ insulin) + Pen/Strep

steps.name: Media change every other day (2)
steps.description: Media change every other day RPMI + B27 (+ insulin) + Pen/Strep

steps.name: Media change every other day (3)
steps.description: Media change every other day RPMI + B27 (+ insulin) + Pen/Strep

steps.name: Media change every other day (4)
steps.description: Media change every other day RPMI + B27 (+ insulin) + Pen/Strep

steps.name: Split diff cells
steps.description: Split the diff cells 1:1 ratio

steps.name: Selection Process
steps.description: Start selection process with Lactate purification
